structure: Part 5 of repos/trade-imports-plants-frontend: Origin, arrival status and arrival details. Read in full the three feature folders under src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features/ — origin/ (page.js, evaluation.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, origin.fit.spec.js), arrival-status/ (page.js, evaluation.js, statuses.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, arrival-status.fit.spec.js) and arrival-details/ (page.js, evaluation.js, fields.js, arrival-bounds.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, arrival-details.fit.spec.js) — plus features/timing-windows.js and obligations/sections/origin.js and arrival.js. To state which countries the origin narrowing allows, ORIGIN_CONSTRAINTS in services/commodities/index.js (outside the slice) was read, and validatorDefaults in src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js was read for the time-format error the arrival-details page shows. Covered: the origin page (route /notifications/{id}/origin, heading, country autocomplete, placeholder, errors including the stale-country and three commodity-category narrowing errors, ware-potato guidance, back link, save controls, where Continue leads); the arrival-status page (route, legend-as-heading, two options with hints quoting the 4-day window, error, gate to plants-for-planting and wood-and-cut-trees only, potatoes skipping it); the arrival-details page (route, heading, a date picker whose label and hint change across three states, the potato-only time and place-of-landing fields, every error, the today cap for already-arrived consignments, no lower bound, Continue to the place of destination); the two timing windows; the five obligations (countryOfOrigin, arrivalStatus, arrivalDate, arrivalTime, proposedPlaceOfLanding); the Welsh machine-draft status of each copy bundle; and every test in the three fit specs (12+2+4+3 origin, 13+3 arrival-status, 7+5+6+2+2 arrival-details). Gaps recorded: no transport or point-of-entry fields for plants and wood on arrival details, and no lateness flag visible in the slice despite the timing-windows comment naming lateness rules. It stops at the place of destination.
